{{Quote|To any Nomai clans whose Vessels can hear this message: It's clear the universe is dying. There are fewer and fewer resources and safe places within space now, so my clan and I believe the best option is for all of our clans to stay together.|Canna}}

'''Canna''' is a modern [[Nomai]] located near Blackrock, somewhere in the Gloaming Galaxy, which they considered to be relatively safe<ref>CANNA: If you can reach the Gloaming Galaxy, we’ve found that Blackrock's suns are fairly stable, and life in this star system is (comparatively) thriving. We live in relative safety.</ref>. 

They encouraged the other remaining Nomai clans to join their clan, as they felt this was the best way to survive.<ref>CANNA: It's clear the universe is dying. There are fewer and fewer resources and safe places within space now, so my clan and I believe the best option is for all of our clans to stay together.</ref> [[Bromi]] and [[Neem]]'s Vessels are on their way to join them.<ref>BROMI: Canna, we’re making our way to you. CANNA: It’s good to hear from you, Bromi! We’ll watch for your Vessel.</ref><ref>NEEM: Not yet, we aren’t, but nearly. We found trouble during our warp: The triple suns of the Bright Spark star system exploded, and it was only a lucky coincidence we weren’t caught in the blast. We’ll meet you soon, Canna!</ref> Canna was worried about Neem's Vessel, as they never arrived and stopped sending messages.<ref>CANNA: Has anyone heard from Neem? His clan was on its way to our Vessel, but they never arrived, and he hasn’t sent any messages. I’m beginning to worry.</ref> It turned out that Neem's Vessel ran into trouble during its warp, but that it was on its way to Canna.<ref>NEEM: Not yet, we aren’t, but nearly. We found trouble during our warp: The triple suns of the Bright Spark star system exploded, and it was only a lucky coincidence we weren’t caught in the blast. We’ll meet you soon, Canna!</ref> Canna was relieved to hear this and told any Vessels nearby that they should be cautious of potentially unstable stars.<ref>CANNA: I’m relieved your clan is safe, Neem! It’s good to hear your words. Any Vessels nearby, remember to be extremely cautious of potentially unstable stars (which is most of them, now).</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Canna's name most likely comes from the ''[[Wikipedia:Canna (plant)|Canna Lily]]''.
